# Ezra Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 468r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/EZR_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:1** And-in-the-year of-one to-Koresh [Cyrus] king of-Paras [Persia], to-complete the-word of-YHWH from-the-mouth of-Yirmeyahu, YHWH stirred-up [he'ir] the-spirit [ruach] of-Koresh king of-Paras, and-he-sent-a-proclamation [qol] in-all his-kingdom, and-also in-writing [mikhtav], saying:

**1:2** "Thus says Koresh king of-Paras: All the-kingdoms of-the-earth YHWH the-God of-the-heavens has-given to-me, and-he has-charged [paqad] me to-build to-him a-house [bayit] in-Yerushalayim which [is] in-Yehudah.

**1:3** Who [is] among-you from-all his-people — may-his-God be with-him — and-let-him-go-up to-Yerushalayim which [is] in-Yehudah, and-let-him-build the-house of-YHWH the-God of-Yisra'el — he [is] the-God — which [is] in-Yerushalayim.

**1:4** And-every-one the-remaining [nish'ar], from-all the-places where he sojourns [gar] there, let-the-men of-his-place lift-him-up [yenas'uhu] with-silver and-with-gold and-with-goods [rekhush] and-with-beasts [behemah], together-with the-freewill-offering [nedavah] for-the-house of-the-God which [is] in-Yerushalayim."

**1:5** And-rose-up the-heads of-the-fathers [ha-avot] of-Yehudah and-Binyamin, and-the-priests [ha-kohanim] and-the-Levites [ha-leviyyim], everyone whose-spirit [ruach] the-God stirred-up [he'ir], to-go-up to-build the-house of-YHWH which [is] in-Yerushalayim.

**1:6** And-all those-around-them strengthened [chizqu] their-hands with-vessels [kelim] of-silver, with-gold, with-goods, with-beasts, and-with-precious-things [migdanot], besides all [that was] freely-offered [hitnadev].

**1:7** And-the-king Koresh brought-out [hotsi] the-vessels of-the-house of-YHWH which Nevukhadnetsar had-brought-out from-Yerushalayim and-had-placed-them [yitnem] in-the-house of-his-gods [elohav].

**1:8** And-brought-them-out Koresh king of-Paras by-the-hand of-Mitredat the-treasurer [ha-gizbar], and-he-counted-them [vayisperem] to-Sheshbatstsar the-prince [ha-nasi] of-Yehudah.

**1:9** And-these [are] their-number [mispar]: basins [agartelei] of-gold — thirty; basins of-silver — a-thousand; knives [machalaflim] — twenty-nine;

**1:10** Bowls [keforei] of-gold — thirty; bowls of-silver of-a-second-kind [mishniyyim] — four-hundred and-ten; other vessels — a-thousand.

**1:11** All the-vessels of-gold and-of-silver — five-thousand and-four-hundred. The-whole [ha-kol] Sheshbatstsar brought-up [he'elah] with the-going-up [he'alot] of-the-exile [ha-golah] from-Bavel to-Yerushalayim.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "stirred up the spirit":** The hiphil of *'ur* (עוּר) — YHWH is the active agent awakening Cyrus's will. The same verb is used for YHWH stirring up adversaries elsewhere (1 Chr 5:26).

**v.2 — Cyrus's declaration:** This decree has a close parallel in the Cyrus Cylinder, though the LC text frames it in Yahwistic terms. The phrase "God of the heavens" (*elohei ha-shamayim*) is characteristic of Persian-period texts.

**v.8 — Sheshbazzar:** Identified as *ha-nasi* (the prince) of Judah, a Davidic title. His identity remains debated — possibly Shenazzar son of Jehoiachin (1 Chr 3:18).

*— EMET*
